documentReferences.label: Consolidated Site Plan Application - Land Use Section

findings.comment: Site is zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4) and is immediately adjacent to SF-3 zoning, triggering applicability of LDC Article 10 Compatibility Standards (eff. July 15, 2024). Site plan does not demonstrate compliance with current Article 10 requirements including height limits, compatibility buffers, or screening provisions. Applicant checked 'No' for compatibility standards applicability on the consolidated application, indicating non-compliance with or misunderstanding of the current Article 10 ordinance.

Site plan does not include compatibility notes specifying which LDC Article 10 sections (25-2-1051 through 25-2-1063) are applicable, nor do notes reflect the current Article 10 ordinance (Ord. 20240516-004, eff. July 15, 2024). The supporting facts reference outdated Subchapter F standards rather than current Article 10. Compatibility notes referencing former § 25-2-1065, § 25-2-1067, or distance tiers (100 ft, 300 ft, 540 ft) would not comply.

Site within 75 feet of triggering property (SF-3 zoning) does not document whether an Article 10 exception applies. Site is neither CBD/DMU, nor a structural alteration-only project, nor proposed for duplex, SF, SF-attached, small-lot SF, two-unit, three-unit, adult care, or child care use; therefore, no exception applies. However, the absence of any Article 10 documentation on the site plan leaves this analysis undocumented.

Project proposes 39 multi-family townhome units arranged in 8 buildings (4-Plex, 5-Plex, 6-Plex configurations). Site plan depicts single Lot 1 from Mecey Subdivision without subdivision into individual townhouse lots. Per LDC § 25-2-775 and master comment response, townhouses require plat of townhouse subdivision with not more than one townhouse per townhouse lot, each with private yard and wall/solid fence on side lot line. Current configuration does not meet this requirement; project must either create townhouse lot subdivision or be redesignated as Multifamily Residential.

Multifamily residential project (39 units) must be located within one-half mile walking distance of public transit route per LDC § 25-1-703(B)(4). Project location map does not show transit routes or distance calculations. No documentation of compliance with transit proximity requirement or director's waiver authorizing deviation (based on high opportunity area, Capital Metro plans, LIHTC, or fair housing purposes) is provided in submitted materials.

Site is located within a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area (confirmed in project facts per LDC § 25-10-152). While general sign compliance note ('All signs must comply with Chapter 25-10') is present on site plan, specific reference to Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements under § 25-10-152 is not included. Site plan must include specific notation addressing nonconforming signs area compliance standards.
